title: Phosphate Buffer Preparation
author: Neilier Junior
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfygjptw

steps.title: Prepare Stock Phosphate Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following two stock solutions of sodium phosphate:

substeps.instruction: Prepare 0.1 M Sodium phosphate monobasic by dissolving 13.8 g L-1 (monohydrate, M.W. 138.0 g mol-1).
Prepare 0.1 M Sodium phosphate dibasic by dissolving 26.8 g L-1 (heptahydrate, M.W. 268.0 g mol-1).

steps.title: Mix Solutions for Desired pH
steps.instruction: Mix the sodium phosphate monobasic and dibasic solutions in the proportions indicated to achieve a pH range between 5.8 and 8.0.

steps.title: Adjust Volume and pH
steps.instruction: Finalize the buffer composition to the required volume and acidity.

substeps.instruction: Adjust the final volume to 200 mL using deionized water.
Adjust the final pH using a sensitive pH meter.
